edits.before: You own levels 1-2: Yuumi brings zero hard CC and can only chip with her Q, so as long as you respect the poke you can walk the lane down. edits.before: From 3 to 6 your engage completely outclasses her peel. Twisted Advance locks her ADC regardless of whether she's attached, and she has no stun, root, or knockback to interrupt you — the best she can do is heal and speed-boost after the fact. Coordinate your W with your ADC's follow-up on her cooldowns; even a mediocre trade snowballs because she can't answer your CC. Ward her flanks and punish any greedy positioning from the carry.
